title: ר' חנינא בריה דר' אדא

paragraphs: R. Chanina son of R. Adda, in R. Tanchum bar Achya's name; see Chana bar Adda above. Chazit Midrash, on “For your love is better.” Jerusalem Berakhot and HaNechenakin have Chananyah, or Chinena, in R. Tanchum bar Chiyya's name. Sheerit Yosef writes Chanan bar Adda, Rav's student—I have not found this. The entry calls Mar Yochana his son.
